sentences.text: Research comprises `` creative work undertaken on a systematic basis in order to increase the stock of knowledge , including knowledge of humans , culture and society , and the use of this stock of knowledge to devise new applications . ''	knowledge	knowledge
It is used to establish or confirm facts , reaffirm the results of previous work , solve new or existing problems , support theorems , or develop new theories .	theories	theory
A research project may also be an expansion on past work in the field .

Research projects can be used to develop further knowledge on a topic , or in the example of a school research project , they can be used to further a student 's research prowess to prepare them for future jobs or reports .	knowledge	knowledge
To test the validity of instruments , procedures , or experiments , research may replicate elements of prior projects or the project as a whole .

The primary purposes of basic research -LRB- as opposed to applied research -RRB- are documentation , discovery , interpretation , or the research and development -LRB- R&D -RRB- of methods and systems for the advancement of human knowledge .	knowledge	knowledge	basic research	basic research	applied research	applied research	documentation	documentation	discovery	Discovery (observation)	interpretation	interpretation (philosophy)	research and development	research and development
Approaches to research depend on epistemologies , which vary considerably both within and between humanities and sciences .	epistemologies	epistemology	humanities	humanities

There are several forms of research : scientific , humanities , artistic , economic , social , business , marketing , practitioner research , life , technological , etc. .	scientific	scientific	humanities	humanities	artistic	artistic	economic	economic	social	social research	business	business	marketing	marketing research	practitioner research	practitioner research	life	life	technological	technological
